Lovely fresh breakfast
Apr 2019 • Friends
We were just walking past this place it looked clean so we stopped in for breakfast. I had an omelette baguette, served in a warm baguette, with tomato, some greens, it was delicious. My friend had the tuna baguette also served in a warm baguette with tomato which she loved. I had a lovely ice milk coffee and she had a passionfruit juice which was also nice.
Staff were super nice and friendly, we are going back. Prices very reasonable, seems like local prices. Coffee about 20k dong and omelette baguette 24k dong
